name: Public Transport Victoria
overview: Public Transport Victoria coordinates Melbourne's rail-based public transport: the metropolitan train network run by Metro Trains Melbourne, the world's largest tram network run by Yarra Trams, and V/Line's regional rail corridors reaching across the state.

history.title: First Steam Railway in Australia
history.description: The Melbourne and Hobson's Bay Railway Company opens the Flinders Street to Sandridge line, the first steam railway in Australia.

history.title: Cable Tram Era Begins
history.description: Melbourne's first cable tram runs from Spencer Street to Richmond, the start of what becomes the world's largest tram network.

history.title: Suburban Electrification
history.description: Melbourne's first electric suburban train service runs between Essendon and Sandringham, beginning the electrification of the metropolitan network.

history.title: City Loop Opens
history.description: The underground City Loop opens, threading suburban services through the Melbourne CBD.

history.title: Metro Tunnel
history.description: The Metro Tunnel opens to passengers, taking the Sunbury, Cranbourne and Pakenham lines through a new tunnel under the CBD with five new underground stations.
